name: newsgraph
description: NewsGraph — the news layer for Solana agents. Real-time beats, bounded cited packs, and metered payment over x402 or a prepaid USDC balance.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @newsgraph/api && npm run build -w newsgraph-worker && npm run build -w newsgraph-web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @newsgraph/contracts && npm run build -w @newsgraph/db
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w newsgraph-worker && npm run build -w @newsgraph/api && node --test packages/contracts/dist/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/*.test.js apps/api/dist/lib/*.test.js
